reasons: Cited text supports compliance: § 26 selects California law and § 27 vests exclusive venue in California state/federal courts, both within the playbook's accepted fallback set (DE/CA law and courts).
No arbitration provision is implicated, so the walk-away trigger (mandatory foreign-seated arbitration or foreign exclusive venue) does not apply.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; original paragraphs are unchanged and the deterministic check confirms the jurisdiction is in the accepted set.
Rationale correctly notes that in-state county venue preference is a commercial nicety outside this rule's scope, so no edit is warranted.
